about_the_game: You find yourself alone in a world where the elements are as dangerous as the creatures that roam it. Freezing winds bite through your clothes, hunger gnaws at your stomach, and the wild surrounds you with constant threats. Survival is not guaranteed — every decision matters. Will you explore the forests and mountains in search of resources, or will you risk venturing into unknown lands hoping to find shelter and safety? Gather wood, stone, and other essential materials to craft tools, weapons, and protective gear. Build a fire to keep warm during long, unforgiving nights, and construct a shelter to defend against both the cold and the dangers that lurk nearby. As you progress, you can upgrade your equipment, craft more advanced tools, and expand your base to face increasingly difficult challenges. Hunger, thirst, and exhaustion are constant threats. You must manage your supplies carefully, hunt and gather food, and purify water to survive. Nature is both a provider and a foe — storms, wild animals, and the harsh climate will test your endurance. Every night survived is a small victory, every meal earned a moment of relief.

short_description: You are alone in the freezing winds. Cold, hunger, and nature are against you. Gather resources, keep your fire alive, build your shelter, and survive each night. Play solo or with your friends.
